headline: Pulses Price Hike: Pulses become more expensive ahead of the festive season; prices rise up to 20% due to increased demand and weak supply %%sep%% %%enurl%% %%sep%% %%sitename%%
summary: Pulse prices in India have risen by up to 20% as demand increases and supply is weak ahead of the festive season. The government says domestic stocks are sufficient and buffer stocks are in place.
why: Pulses are a key protein source in India, and their prices feed directly into food inflation tracked by the central bank.
